title: Calculation of the Owner Share on a Prorated Seal-Failure Replacement under Warranty Coverage
content:
**Clause.** Under Warranty Coverage, the proration share is the share the plan's proration ladder sets for the full years from the coverage start date to the claim filing date, counting a year only once its anniversary has been reached, an anniversary that falls on a day the month lacks falling back to the last day of that month: one half for the Ridgeline Limited Warranty once five full years have been reached and for the Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty once ten full years have been reached, one quarter for the Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty once ten full years have been reached, and nothing in any other case. The replacement charge per sealed unit is the published sealed-unit replacement charge. The owner's share is the proration share times the replacement charge per sealed unit times the units approved on the claim's decision. A share of zero books nothing.

**Order of working.** The replacement charge per sealed unit is the glass build charge plus the insulating upgrade and the glazing upgrade; the proration share of it times the units approved gives the gross share; the gross share is reduced by the volume rate and the result is then reduced by the owner discount; the visit credit is deducted from what remains, never below zero; and the share is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, an amount exactly halfway between two cents going to the higher cent. The glass build charge is the published sealed-unit replacement charge, and the upgrades, the volume rate, the owner discount and the visit credit are zero.

The published sealed-unit replacement charge is the figure of the glass proration schedule.

## Proration share

| Plan | Full years from coverage start to the filing date | Proration share |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 5 or more | one half (0.5) |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 10 or more | one half (0.5) |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 10 or more | one quarter (0.25) |
| any plan, any other case | — | nothing |

Under the Ridgeline Limited Warranty, 4 full years give nothing and 5 full years give one half.

## Full years — boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Coverage start | Claim filed | Full years |
|---|---|---|
| 10 April 2035 | 9 April 2040 | 4 |
| 10 April 2035 | 10 April 2040 | 5 |
| 29 February 2036 | 27 February 2041 | 4 |
| 29 February 2036 | 28 February 2041 | 5 (February 2041 lacks a 29th, so the anniversary falls back to 28 February) |

## Worked figure (hypothetical published charge 200.00)

A Ridgeline Limited Warranty claim filed after 6 full years, 2 units approved: one half of 200.00 is 100.00, times 2 units gives 200.00 as the owner's share. The same claim under the Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty gives nothing, and nothing is booked.
